scripts.prod: cd frontend && NEXT_DIST_DIR=.next-prod npx next build && NEXT_DIST_DIR=.next-prod npx next start -p 3000

scripts.start: cd frontend && NEXT_DIST_DIR=.next-prod npx next start -p 3000
